Analysis: Both hypotheses are notably innovative, but Hypothesis 2 offers a clearer, more modular approach. While Hypothesis 1 leverages advanced biomaterials, dynamic ECM tuning, and real-time imaging—which are highly novel, the complexity of integrating these elements raises challenges in feasibility and systematic testing. Hypothesis 2, on the other hand, targets a distinct metabolic axis (the exosomal PKM2–PFKFB3 pathway) with precision nanocarrier delivery, making it somewhat more straightforward to dissect mechanistically and validate incrementally in preclinical settings. Furthermore, its design seems marginally more plausible and testable, with a clearer path to safety evaluation through controlled nanocarrier optimization. Therefore, Hypothesis 2 is favored.
